title: NVIDIA argues agent harness design can change performance as much as model choice
friendlyTitle: Better agent software can improve the same AI model
summary: NVIDIA’s open-source NOOA research preview represents an agent as a typed Python object with explicit state, code-based actions, pass-by-reference data and model-callable context controls. NVIDIA reports substantial benchmark and token-efficiency gains with the same underlying models, though these are vendor-reported results.
friendlySummary: NVIDIA built an open agent framework around typed data, clear state and normal Python code. Its tests suggest the software around a model can strongly change results and cost.
whyItMatters: Model rankings alone do not predict how a working agent will perform. Teams can improve reliability and cost by testing typed interfaces, bounded context views, inspectable state and ordinary software-engineering practices before paying for a larger model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Before buying a more expensive model, a team may get better results by improving how its agent stores information and uses tools.
